# Root Cause Analysis Recommendation

Based on the context provided, **Glance (the image service) is the true root cause**, as indicated by the constraint referencing "Glance image download errors." 

The nova-scheduler errors are secondary symptoms resulting from Glance's inability to provide images. I recommend prioritizing investigation and resolution of the Glance image service's download functionality, as fixing this will likely resolve the cascading nova-scheduler failures.
